title: pet
summary: Current Benilla's realized pet contract is seven client verbs (CMSG_PET_ACTION, CMSG_PET_STOP_ATTACK, CMSG_PET_CANCEL_AURA, CMSG_PET_SET_ACTION, CMSG_PET_SPELL_AUTOCAST, CMSG_PET_ABANDON and CMSG_PET_RENAME) plus four server packets (SMSG_PET_SPELLS including the zero-guid teardown and both cooldown tail shapes, SMSG_PET_MODE, SMSG_PET_ACTION_FEEDBACK and SMSG_PET_CAST_FAILED). MSUI implements the whole reachable desktop set: the action bar, pet spellbook autocast, and the rule-owned pet menu/abandon/two-step rename popup chain all use the exact packet bodies.
